SELECT
  cur.region AS region,
  cur.revenue AS current_period,
  prev.revenue AS previous_period,
  cur.revenue - prev.revenue AS change,
  (
    cur.revenue - prev.revenue
  ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev.revenue, 0) AS change_pct

  SELECT

  SELECT

    SUM(o.net_amount) AS revenue
  FROM fact_orders AS o
  JOIN dim_date AS d
    ON o.order_date = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_customer AS c

    o.status = 'completed' AND d.fiscal_year = 2025

    c.region
  ORDER BY
    revenue DESC NULLS FIRST
